notes.hook: The hook is undermined by the confusing use of the word 'unexploded' instead of 'unexplored'.
notes.clarity: Calling Pluto 'unexploded' and saying the probe sped 'toward the solar system' makes no sense.
notes.payoff: The reveal that the actual 1991 stamp was carried onboard all the way to Pluto is a perfect payoff.
notes.visuals: The visuals are sharp and clean, though using 2015 Pluto photos to represent the 1991 stamp is anachronistic.
notes.loop: The loop is structurally seamless but repeats the incorrect 'unexploded' line from the hook.

rewrite: Beat 1: A postage stamp declaring Pluto unexplored inspired a spacecraft to visit it.
Beat 6: A Jupiter gravity assist shaved three years off the voyage, sending the probe speeding toward the outer solar system.
Beat 9: A postage stamp declaring Pluto unexplored inspired a spacecraft to visit it.
rounds.better_than_last: This episode has a much more narrative and emotionally satisfying historical payoff than the factual trivia of the recent episodes.
